How To Play Cribbage

Two players race their pegs around the board. The first to reach 121 points wins — the moment you get there, even in the middle of a hand.

1. The Deal & the Crib

Each player gets 6 cards. You each put 2 cards face down into the crib. The crib belongs to the dealer and is scored by the dealer at the end of the hand. The deal switches every hand.

In CribMagic: click two cards to pick them, then press Send to Crib.

2. The Starter

A card is cut from the deck and turned face up. It counts as part of both hands and the crib. If it is a Jack, the dealer pegs 2 points ("his heels").

3. The Play (pegging)

Starting with the non-dealer, players take turns laying cards face up, calling out the running total. The total can never go over 31. Aces count 1, face cards count 10.

  • Making the count exactly 15 — 2 points
  • Making the count exactly 31 — 2 points
  • A pair (same rank as the card just played) — 2; three of a kind — 6; four of a kind — 12
  • A run of 3 or more among the last cards played, in any order — 1 point per card
  • If you can't play without going over 31, you say "Go". Your opponent keeps playing if they can. Whoever plays the last card before the count resets gets 1 point (or 2 for hitting 31).

In CribMagic: cards you can play glow gold — click one to play it. If none fit, press Go.

4. The Show

After all cards are played, hands are counted with the starter: non-dealer first, then dealer, then the dealer's crib.

  • Every combination of cards adding to 15 — 2 points
  • Each pair — 2 points
  • Each run of 3 or more — 1 point per card (double runs count twice)
  • Flush: 4 cards of one suit in your hand — 4 (5 if the starter matches). The crib only scores a 5-card flush.
  • His nobs: the Jack of the same suit as the starter — 1 point

CribMagic counts every hand for you and lists each score so you can see where every point came from. The best possible hand is 29!

Winning

First to 121 wins. If your opponent hasn't reached 91, that's a skunk!
